files.use: Reviewed native control-surface request contract; this branch publishes one immutable shared value and uses its existing BackendRequest.
Adapt four outside work-area candidates into the existing shared RecordingWorkspace; retain independently verified per-screen mapping and existing source/session/claim ownership.
Reviewed toolbar sizing and movement. This branch retains its existing UI and adds continuous safe-area constraints rather than trusting only its initial position.
Reviewed real XCB geometry/translation readback. Extend this branch's sole X11Capture with checked native SHAPE and short atomic server-grab/readback; no second capture implementation.

notAdopted: A control that cannot fit must not proceed only with an advisory warning.
A one-time geometry check does not cover later moves, resizes or native-ID replacement.
A new session or source owner is not introduced for the shared toolbar.
Wayland buffer freshness is not inferred from an X11 rectangle or an arbitrary delay.
verification: Shared UI and native X11 probe compiled locally with fixed Qt 6.12.1; actual QWidget cases ran offscreen. Native Windows/X11 compositor and physical-desktop pixel acceptance remain separate tests.
